description: Audit a set of Kubernetes manifests against a contract the caller states. Reports an image with no tag or the latest tag, which changes under you; absent resource requests or limits; absent readiness or liveness probes; a missing required label; hostNetwork, hostPID, a hostPath volume or a privileged container; and a credential-shaped environment variable set to a literal, whose value is never echoed. YAML parsing surprises are reported rather than inherited. Pay 160000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

contract.description: The rules to apply. An unknown property here is refused rather than ignored.

require_security_context.description: Report a container that does not set runAsNonRoot and allowPrivilegeEscalation. Defaults to false.

manifests.description: The manifests to audit, in one multi-document stream. YAML, read as a documented subset: block mappings and sequences, flow collections of scalars, block scalars, and multiple documents separated by ---. Anchors, aliases, merge keys and explicit tags are refused with the line rather than half parsed. Nothing is fetched: no cluster, registry or repository is contacted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.
manifests.example:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  labels:
    app: web
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: ghcr.io/example/web:latest
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256M
            limits:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 512Mi
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_PASSWORD
              value: hunter2
            - name: FEATURE_FLAG
              value: no

name: kubernetes_manifest_audit

checked.description: Which checks ran, so a contract that switched everything off is visible rather than reading as a pass.

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

conformant.description: True only when every document parsed and every check that ran found nothing.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Kubernetes Manifest Audit
